zoneRate.label: Shipping rates
zoneRate.title: Shipping rates
zoneRate.description: Calculated shipping by zone and chargeable weight. Rates are set in the shipping config file; this page is read-only.
zoneRate.notConfigured: The zone-rate provider is not registered in the Fulfillment Module. See the README to set it up.

rates.noExchangeRates: No exchange rates: carts in another currency are refused.
rates.fallbackOn: Product weight and dimensions are used when a variant has none.
rates.fallbackOff: Only variant weight and dimensions are used.
rates.formula: Chargeable weight = the larger of actual and volumetric (L × W × H / divisor) weight, rounded up to a whole kg, at least 1 kg.

incomplete.description: These variants have no weight or are missing a dimension, so checkout refuses to price shipping for them. Fill in weight (g) and length, width and height (cm) on the variant.
incomplete.empty: Every variant has a weight and all dimensions.

rejections.description: Each time checkout could not price shipping. Repeats for the same cart are counted on one row.
